Villa Amenities

Everything You Need for the Perfect Private Staycation

Adult & Kiddie Pool
Enjoy a refreshing swim in the private adult pool while the kids safely splash around in the kiddie pool. Perfect for family outings, barkada trips, and weekend staycations near Manila.
Air-Conditioned Rooms
Stay comfortable all day with fully air-conditioned bedrooms and indoor spaces — ideal for relaxing after swimming or celebrating.
Videoke & Entertainment
Connect our Bluetooth speaker with microphone to the TV and enjoy karaoke sessions using YouTube with family and friends.
Billiard Table & Board Games
Challenge your group to billiards or enjoy classic board games for nonstop bonding and entertainment.
BBQ Grill & Outdoor Kitchen
Cook your favorite meals with our free BBQ grill and enjoy memorable gatherings in the alfresco dining area. Perfect for late-night inuman, cookouts, and family feasts.
Wi-Fi & Netflix
Stay connected with high-speed Wi‑Fi and enjoy Netflix streaming for movie nights and relaxing downtime.
Pet Friendly
Bring your dogs along for the trip. Villa Elohai is a pet-friendly private resort in Bulacan.
Parking & Easy Access
Convenient on-site parking is available for guests, with easy road access from Manila and nearby areas.
Fully Equipped Kitchen
Prepare and enjoy your favorite meals with our fully equipped kitchen, complete with essential cooking and dining essentials.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Villa Elohai a fully private resort?

+

Yes. Villa Elohai is a fully exclusive private resort in San Ildefonso, Bulacan. The entire villa, pool, and amenities are exclusively for your group only.

How far is Villa Elohai from Manila?

+

Villa Elohai is approximately 1 hour away from Metro Manila, depending on traffic conditions.

Is Villa Elohai pet-friendly?

+

Yes. We welcome pets, especially dogs, so your whole family can enjoy the staycation together.

How many guests can Villa Elohai accommodate?

+

The villa is good for up to 15 guests. Maximum capacity is 20 guests with an additional ₱800 per head beyond 15 pax.

Is cooking allowed?

+

Yes. Guests may use the fully equipped kitchen, BBQ grill, and outdoor cooking area during their stay.

Is there parking available?

+

Yes. Villa Elohai offers convenient on-site parking for guests.

Is Wi-Fi included?

+

Yes. High-speed Wi-Fi and Netflix access are included during your stay.

What are the check-in and check-out times?

+

Day Tour: Check-in 8:00 AM · Check-out 5:00 PM
Overnight Stay: Check-in 2:00 PM · Check-out 11:00 AM
Night Tour: Check-in 7:00 PM · Check-out 5:00 AM
